subject: Capacity signal & procurement handshake for EmberAI dedicated pool
messages:
From: Alyssa Greene <alyssa@ember.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Dedicated pool request + lead-time signal for Q4 launch

Hi Sean / Vanessa,

Thanks for taking the call earlier. EmberAI is targeting a phased launch of our "Composer" product with an internal pilot in mid‑Oct and broad availability in early Nov. We evaluated Redwood's Dedicated offering and want to pursue a committed pool, roughly: 

- Initial tranche: 20x A100-class GPUs (or equivalent q8) for pilot (Oct)
- Second tranche: 60x GPUs for GA (Nov)
- Preference for us-west-2 and a smaller fallback in us-east-1

Key asks:
1) Firm OEM lead-time estimate for the preferred SKU (we need a procurement window to secure funding).
2) A proposed tranche delivery cadence and suggested carveouts if OEM can only do partial shipping.
3) A written fallback plan (cloud backfill options + costs) if OEM timing slips beyond 14 weeks.

I'm attaching our requirements spec (EmberAI_requirements_v1.pdf). Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide a provisional OEM quote and the cloud fallbacks you discussed?

Thanks,
Alyssa Greene
Head of Infrastructure, EmberAI
(attachment: EmberAI_requirements_v1.pdf)
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Alyssa Greene <alyssa@ember.ai>
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2027 09:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Dedicated pool request + lead-time signal for Q4 launch

Team — looping you in. Quick summary and asks: 

- Karthik: can you validate current OEM queue (OEMTech / Lars) and confirm lead-time windows for the A100-class SKU vs a newer Ampere variant? We need both best-case and conservative estimates.
- Kimberly: please draft a preliminary OEM quote (include per-unit MSRP, shipping windows, customs & domestic logistics assumptions). Attach an initial sizing table once you have numbers.
- Vanessa: please start a customer-facing mutual action plan (MAP) with milestone dates for procurement sign-off and billing triggers.

Alyssa — we'll aim to get a provisional OEM quote + tranche schedule within 48–72 hours. If OEM lead time is >14 weeks, we'll include a priced cloud-reserve fallback and a suggested split (e.g., 40% OEM / 60% cloud until SKU arrives).

Thanks,
Sean
Sean Gallagher
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.com

On Thu, Jun 24, 2027 at 09:12 AM Alyssa Greene <alyssa@ember.ai> wrote:
> Hi Sean / Vanessa,
> 
> Thanks for taking the call earlier...
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Alyssa Greene <alyssa@ember.ai>, Lars Henriksen <lars@oemtech.com>, Tom Rios <tom.rios@cloudvendor.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 14:06:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated pool request + lead-time signal for Q4 launch

Thanks for the ping. I spoke with Lars at OEMTech this morning and got the following: 

- Preferred SKU (OEMTech 80GB Ampere equivalent): current quoted lead time = 16–20 weeks from PO acceptance.
- Alternate SKU (OEMTech 40GB Ampere, higher availability): 10–12 week lead time but lower perf-per-dollar for Ember's workload.
- OEM can split shipments into two physical tranches (partial pick/pack) but blanks their shipping schedule in calendar-week batches — typically a 2–3 week window for the pilot tranche and a 3–4 week window for GA tranche.

Implications / proposal:
- If Ember wants to hit an Oct pilot, we need a PO and deposit on the 40GB lane by early Jul (target: 07/08/2027) for the 10–12 week SKU.
- If Ember prefers the 80GB lane for long-term unit cost, expect Oct pilot to slip unless we accept staggered delivery (pilot on 40GB, GA on 80GB later).
- Recommended procurement handshake: 30% deposit on PO, staged invoices aligned to shipment tranches.

Cloud fallback: I looped in Tom at CloudVendor — they have short-term reserved capacity in us-west-2 (nonexclusive) that we can pre-book on a 3‑month commit while OEM fulfills. Tom indicated a premium ~20% above current per-token hosted rate for dedicated reserved nodes.

I've attached a working quote (OEM_quote_v3.xlsx) and an initial sizing table (initial-sizing-table.csv) with per-tranche numbers and cost delta scenarios.

Next steps:
- Kimberly to formalize the OEM quote (include customs + inland freight).
- Vanessa to draft MAP and call out PO trigger dates.
- Sean to confirm customer timeline and proposed deposit cadence with Alyssa.

-Karthik
Head of Procurement Operations, Redwood
(attachment: OEM_quote_v3.xlsx; initial-sizing-table.csv)

On Thu, Jun 24, 2027 at 09:34 AM Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com> wrote:
> Team — looping you in...
From: Alyssa Greene <alyssa@ember.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 11:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated pool request + lead-time signal for Q4 launch

Sean / team—

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the initial quote. A few clarifications from Ember's side: 

- We prefer not to mix SKU families across tranches if it materially changes runtime behavior; pilot on 40GB is acceptable only if the performance delta is documented and Ember ops signs off.
- Ember is prepared to do a deposit (30%) if we get a binding delivery window. Can you confirm what protections Redwood provides if OEM misses the committed shipment window (credits? priority replacement lanes?).
- We'd like to explore a short-term escrow for the deposit (third-party escrow or Redwood-managed) and an SLA for lead-time breach remediation.

I've attached an SLA template Ember prefers (EmberAI_SLA_Request.pdf). Also: please share the finalized MAP and a DocuSign link for the PO path so procurement can queue approvals.

Thanks,
Alyssa
(attachment: EmberAI_SLA_Request.pdf)

On Fri, Jun 25, 2027 at 02:06 PM Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com> wrote:
> Thanks for the ping...
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Greene <alyssa@ember.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2027 15:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated pool request + procurement handshake for EmberAI

Alyssa — thanks for the pointer on escrow and the SLA doc. Quick MAP and next steps so we have a single source of truth: 

Mutual Action Plan (high level):
- 07/02/2027: Redwood to deliver formal OEM quote (final MSRP, Incoterms, customs estimate) and revised tranche schedule (Karthik/Kimberly).
- 07/05/2027: Ember to approve sizing table and sign PO authorization.
- 07/08/2027: Target PO acceptance and deposit (30%) to escrow.
- 07/12/2027: Redwood to confirm booking with OEM and provide estimated ship weeks for pilot tranche.
- Continuous: CloudVendor short-term reserved capacity to be provisioned by Redwood if OEM slips beyond agreed window (Tom Rios contact).

Protections / breach remedies (preliminary):
- If OEM misses a committed shipment week by >2 weeks, Redwood will (a) provide a prorated credit against the first month of billing for the affected tranche or (b) enable expedite lanes through CloudVendor at Redwood's cost for the first 2 weeks while OEM remediation proceeds. Exact remedy to be captured in PO/SLA.

Action items assigned: 
- Karthik: finalize OEM quote and Incoterms (due 07/02).
- Kimberly: add customs / logistics line items to quote (due 07/02).
- Vanessa: produce a customer-facing MAP doc and a DocuSign PO (due 07/05).
- Sean: create the HubSpot deal record and update milestones (hubspot link below).

I'll follow up with the DocuSign link as soon as Vanessa publishes the PO.

Sean
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
